host: Halo B (test001-stxh), AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 / Radeon 8060S gfx1151, 128GB config, 96GB VRAM carveout, ROCm 7.2.0
mem_note: GPU-resident footprint = VRAM carveout used + GTT used (rocm-smi, sampled 0.4s). Reported peak_gpu_gb is the SUSTAINED compute-phase peak (held >=2s); a sub-second model-load page-cache transient (cap_32gb raw max 54.40 GB) is excluded so the cap row reflects the true GPU-resident working set (~32GB). On the 96GB-carveout config the BF16 weights land in the VRAM carveout (GTT ~0).
honesty: Accelerates the AI model (RAG generator), NOT the proof; RISC0 STARK stays CPU-only. Measured on Halo B (128GB/96GB-carveout Strix Halo), NOT the presenter Z2 (whose ROCr compute pool caps at ~47GiB and cannot hold a 54GB BF16 model). The 32GB-cap contrast is generous to a discrete card (CPU spill here is the same LPDDR5X, not PCIe). CPU (-ngl 0) baseline omitted: the 54GB BF16 model far exceeds the ~30GB system RAM under the 96GB carveout, so an -ngl 0 run measures NVMe thrash, not CPU compute (it hit the 420s cap during load).
